name: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Zee-Nine City Seven)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Zee-Nine City Seven)
description: An RA-7 protocol droid was used by Imperial Lieutenant Enric Pryde during their inspection duty on the settlement Zee-Nine City Seven, just prior to a skirmish at the city.
